source.title: Report on solutions to open problems from the book "Topological groups and related structures"

trace.notes: Normalized ARGUMENTS as the single zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/7104533 with trailing identifier 7104533.

Failure mode: network_or_dns_failure plus metadata_only. Local shell fetches of zbmath.org and api.zbmath.org failed because DNS/network access is unavailable in the sandbox, and the browser reader could not fetch the supplied zbMATH record as a readable full-text artifact. Local workflow metadata identifies the exact work as M. Tkachenko, 'Report on solutions to open problems from the book "Topological groups and related structures",' 2019; web-indexed zbMATH author metadata corroborates the title and Zbl 1425.54018. This metadata was used only for source identity and title recovery.
evidence_refs: search: "Report on solutions to open problems from the book" "Tkachenko"

trace.notes: Bounded exact-work recovery attempted searches for the zbMATH identifier, the exact title, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus DOI/OpenAlex/Crossref-style terms, and Tkachenko plus title variants. Candidate pages were zbMATH author-profile metadata, a MaRDI page for a different 2024 survey that cites the target title, the 2008 book 'Topological groups and related structures' itself, book metadata pages from Springer/ResearchGate/WorldCat/CiNii/Google Books, and later related papers such as a 2023 paper solving Problem 8.6.3 from the book. These were rejected because they are metadata-only, citation-only, the related source book rather than the 2019 report, or different works. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the report body/problem statements was recovered.
evidence_refs: search: "Report on solutions to open problems from the book" "Topological groups and related structures"
search: "Report on solutions to open problems from the book" "Zbl 1425.54018"

trace.notes: Source adequacy gate failed. The workflow did not extract questions from resolver metadata, search snippets, the related book, citation lists, or later papers because no readable exact-work primary source for the zbMATH-resolved 2019 report was recovered.
